caption: The drawing depicts a single green glass bottle placed upright at the center of a rectangular off-white or beige background. The bottle has a cylindrical body with a narrow neck that flares out slightly at the lip. The top of the bottle has a thicker rim, and the base is solid and rounded. The word "SARATOGA" is embossed in capital letters on the upper part of the bottle’s body, following the curvature of the glass. The bottle is shaded to suggest thickness and transparency, with darker green shadows and lighter, more translucent areas highlighting its reflective surface and interior curves. The drawing is bordered by a double-lined rectangular frame, which is itself positioned on a slightly larger sheet of paper. In the bottom right corner inside the inner border, there is a handwritten signature that reads "Anna Alvisi." No additional objects or background details are present.
title: Bottle (For Spring Water)
